decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio and costs little to keep, and two years are still too few to show whether its value will be realized.
As a flagship of the firm's LED and optics direction, the microprismatic pendant is a strategic option that deserves further commitment rather than abandonment.
Dropping the naval lighting line and LED substitution weaken the case for HMI searchlights, but with no clear negative results the low-cost niche option stays open for one more period.
The marine searchlight still serves the robust specialist segment cheaply, though the exit from naval lighting raises some doubt about the firm's commitment to marine products.
